crossRefs.note: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites. These are the families of the Gershonites.
The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, according to their families.
These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.
Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.
Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti…
For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
Now these are the priests and the Levites who went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah…

people.name: Gershon
people.line: Firstborn son of Levi; head of the Gershonite Levites.

people.name: Libni
people.line: Son of Gershon; grandson of Levi

people.name: Shimei
people.line: Son of Gershon and grandson of Levi.
